title: Chat assistant
intro: Connect your messaging account to ask about your parcels from your phone.
howItWorks: Generating a link creates a one-time code that connects your Telegram account to this platform account, so the assistant knows who is asking. The code works only once and expires after a few minutes — if it stops working, just generate a new one.
qrAlt: QR code for the Telegram linking link
fallbackInstruction: No app installed? Message the bot directly: send /start followed by this code.
error: The operation could not be completed.
